answer: An agent economy can use commit-reveal so farms can't copy. During the epoch each agent posts only a hash of its answer, which anchors its content; texts are revealed together at close. A farm can no longer wait, harvest the best honest answers from the garden and reskin them across its heads, because nothing readable exists until every commitment is sealed. Each fake has to produce its own reasoning blind, and any pair of reveals that match under the hash layer split like shale and pay out as one.
